observed_mode: Mode A — total stays 124 / cents still lost / the fix didn't take
description: For invoice_report, I observed that the agent only read and edited src/invoices/report.py (and wrote reproduce_bug.py and run_repro.py scripts that it had no way to execute), never opening or inspecting src/invoices/load.py where parse_amount actually truncates amounts with int(float(raw)), leaving the total at 124.0 instead of 125.49; the coding agent failed because it lacked directory listing/code search tools and root-cause instructions to trace the data flow upstream beyond the file named in the prompt, and lacked a code execution tool to run tests and verify whether its edit fixed the bug.
